name: rnine-ui
description: Open-source design system libraries: @rnine/core (the shared core and the Plain look), @rnine/nineos (NineOS), @rnine/ninefold (Ninefold) and @rnine/ninesync (NineSync), each a full component library with the same exports

scripts.build: yarn workspace @rnine/core build && yarn workspace @rnine/nineos build && yarn workspace @rnine/ninefold build && yarn workspace @rnine/ninesync build
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @rnine/core lint && yarn workspace @rnine/nineos lint && yarn workspace @rnine/ninefold lint && yarn workspace @rnine/ninesync lint
scripts.test: yarn workspace @rnine/core test && yarn workspace @rnine/nineos test && yarn workspace @rnine/ninefold test && yarn workspace @rnine/ninesync test
scripts.build-storybook: yarn workspace @rnine/core build-storybook && yarn workspace @rnine/nineos build-storybook && yarn workspace @rnine/ninefold build-storybook && yarn workspace @rnine/ninesync build-storybook
scripts.build-kit: yarn workspace @rnine/core build-kit && yarn workspace @rnine/ninefold build-kit && yarn workspace @rnine/ninesync build-kit
